an5.209:1.1: pañcime bhikkhave ādīnavā āyatakena gītassarena dhammaṃ bhaṇantassa
an5.209:1.3: attāpi tasmiṃ sare sārajjati parepi tasmiṃ sare sārajjanti gahapatikāpi ujjhāyanti
an5.209:1.4: yatheva mayaṃ gāyāma evamevime samaṇā sakyaputtiyā gāyantīti sarakuttimpi nikāmayamānassa samādhissa bhaṅgo hoti pacchimā janatā diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati
an5.209:1.5: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā āyatakena gītassarena dhammaṃ bhaṇantassāti.
